vulnerability_title: Malicious users can take advan-tage of the rounding direction of a high-value & low-decimal asset

recommendation.recommendation_text:
Due to the current rounding direction, an additional 1 or 2 wei of assets is added to the
debt, and the intention is to always favor the protocol by having the users (borrower)
repay more debts instead of the other way round.
However, the issue here is that another group of protocol users (lenders) indirectly
benefits from the extra 1 or 2 wei of assets given to them, which opens up the
opportunity for some lenders to exploit this to their advantage.
One possible solution is to discard the excess premium debt dust (1-2 wei) resulting from
rounding errors to ensure that neither the borrower nor the lenders benefit from the
rounding direction.

content_code_consistency.content_reasoning: _notifyRiskPremiumUpdate computes accruedPremium as previewRestoreByShares, rounded up, minus premiumOffset, which was set with previewDrawByShares, rounded down. Each call can add one or two wei of premium debt, and a user can call updateUserRiskPremium on their own position as often as they like.
patterns_found: accruedPremium uses a value rounded up minus an offset rounded down
updateUserRiskPremium can be called repeatedly by the position owner
issues: The 2 wei tolerance in Hub._applyPremiumDelta and the effect on totalAddedAssets and the share price are in Hub.sol, another file.

scsvs_classification.vulnerability_type: rounding mismatch inflates premium debt on each risk premium update
